opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other UK institutions of higher education, and (on a trial basis) UK-based independent research institutes/organisations. The Principal Investigator must be employed by the eligible institution.
opportunities.summary: For researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education to undertake an innovative and original research project. The outline stage is paused; detailed applications are accepted from invited applicants by 1 September 2026.
discipline_tags: All disciplines except medical/clinical research, policy-influencing research, and research with immediate commercial application

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships

amount.raw: Applications are invited for a minimum of £10,000 and a maximum of £150,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas. Applications must be made by a member of academic staff based in a UK university with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: For UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance the skills and knowledge of academic staff and students in an underrepresented area of research within the UK.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness/disabilities and research intended to inform clinical practice

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Trust contributes 100% of the Fellow's salary up to £56,000 in year one, then 50% up to £28,000 in years two and three; plus up to £6,000 per annum in research expenses.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers with a research record who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post. Must hold a doctorate by the time of taking up the Fellowship.
opportunities.summary: For early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work, tenable for 3 years at UK universities with research degree awarding powers.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness/disabilities and research intended to inform clinical practice

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Centenary Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million will be made to UK universities in this round.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any UK university that holds research degree awarding powers in its own right; consortia of a maximum of two universities are also accepted.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to fund up to 30 Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships in an interdisciplinary priority research area, including additional studentships for underrepresented groups, postdoctoral opportunities and programme administration costs.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research, research council priorities, policy-driven research, advocacy, and commercial application

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships

amount.raw: The maximum value of a Fellowship is £70,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that extends beyond the duration of the Fellowship, resident in the UK at the time of application.
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research, tenable for between 3 and 24 months. Application materials will be available on the page in September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness/disabilities and research intended to inform clinical practice

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships

amount.raw: Applications are invited for a minimum value of £3,000 and a maximum of £24,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post at a UK university with research degree or taught degree awarding powers, or an eligible Independent Research Organisation/Institute.
opportunities.summary: For senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post to complete a research project and prepare the results for publication. Application materials will be available on the page during September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness/disabilities and research intended to inform clinical practice

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million is available for up to 10 years.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities defined as an institution registered by the Office for Students and holding its own research degree awarding powers. A centre may be based at a single university or be a collaboration between multiple institutions.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. The Centenary round is expected to open in February 2027 for submission of outline applications in June 2027.
discipline_tags: Any topic in the Trust's remit, excluding medical/clinical research

opportunities.title: Centenary Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: The awards will be for up to £1 million, for staff salaries and associated costs.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Talented early career scholars embarking on a university career, at lecturer level or equivalent, with at least two years' full-time or equivalent experience after PhD, holding a permanent academic appointment at a UK university.
opportunities.summary: For talented scholars who are embarking on a university career to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem. The Centenary round will open in January 2028 for submission in May 2028.
discipline_tags: Any research area except medical/clinical research, policy-driven research, advocacy, and commercial application
